exposure: Patients with mature or immature teratoma
outcome: Long-term results including bladder-bowel dysfunction and neurological impairment
finding: This prospective study of 41 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma found an overall survival of 95% at a mean follow-up of 54 months.
mod_finding: The study mentions mode of delivery in the context of data collection, but it focuses on the management and outcomes of sacrococcygeal teratoma and does not analyze any relationship with mode of delivery.
